intro: The Senate display unit blends functionality and style effortlessly. With focused lighting and ample storage, it enhances modern living spaces while keeping your collectibles beautifully showcased.

features.title: Laminated love, built to last
features.text: Crafted with durable, high-quality particle boards, this unit promises long-lasting strength and a premium finish for modern, busy households.

features.title: Elegant glass doors with dust protection
features.text: Toughened glass doors not only enhance the aesthetics but also protect your belongings from dust, ensuring a clean and clear display every time.

features.title: Ample space to display collectibles
features.text: Showcase your prized possessions in a generously spacious design, ensuring everything from heirlooms to decor pieces has a secure and elegant home.

features.title: Integrated focused lighting for highlights
features.text: Museum-inspired focused lighting creates a captivating display by highlighting your items, adding ambient warmth and turning any space into a conversation starter.

features.title: Knockdown construction for easy assembly
features.text: Its simple knockdown design ensures hassle-free setup and relocation, perfectly suited for evolving spaces and contemporary living.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
